items.title: How new tech billionaires can save more lives
items.summary: An argument piece says effective altruism donors could save more lives by funding policy change rather than only tangible products. It compares the cost per life saved of bed nets (about $5,500) with trans fat advocacy (under $5 per life) and estimates a hypertension medication program could prevent at least 22,000 heart attacks, strokes, and deaths for under $1,000 each. It notes that AI and tech donors may soon give tens of billions of dollars a year.

items.title: Proposition 40 and the question at the heart of America’s safety net: Who should pay?
